data: Tesla's fiscal 2024 revenue was about $97.69 billion, and NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 revenue, which ended in late January 2024, was about $60.92 billion. Tesla's figure is roughly 1.6 times NVIDIA's, so the bigger company by revenue is Tesla. NVIDIA's fiscal year naming differs from the calendar year, so its FY2024 covers February 2023 through January 2024, while Tesla's covers calendar 2024.
